program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    baseline = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row)), None)
    if baseline is None:
        return out
    for c, value in enumerate(grid[baseline]):
        if value not in (2, 8):
            continue
        top = baseline - (4 if value == 2 else 3)
        for r in range(top, baseline):
            out[r][c] = value if r == top else 1
    return out
'''
